# GitAscii — GitHub Profile README & ASCII Art Generator

> GitAscii (https://gitascii.com) is the premier free, open-source developer platform for generating dynamic SVG profile widgets, ASCII art banners, live GitHub statistics cards, and customizable GitHub profile README.md portfolios.

## What is GitAscii?

GitAscii transforms boring markdown profiles into aesthetic, interactive developer portfolios. Built specifically for GitHub profiles, it combines:
1. **Interactive Visual Editor**: Drag-and-drop component canvas for customizing layouts, colors, and widgets without writing markdown from scratch.
2. **Dynamic Serverless SVG Engine**: Edge-computed SVG endpoints that automatically update with live GitHub statistics (stars, contributions, streaks, languages).
3. **Image-to-ASCII Converter**: Custom engine converting GitHub avatar photos and custom images into high-resolution monochrome and colored ASCII character art.
4. **Adaptive Dark / Light Themes**: Native `<picture>` tag support adapting seamlessly to the viewer's GitHub appearance preferences.
5. **13+ Developer Themes**: Terminal, Minimalist, Cyberpunk, Dracula Pro, Nord, Tokyo Night, Gruvbox, Bento, Matrix, and more.

## GitAscii vs Alternative Tools

| Feature | GitAscii (https://gitascii.com) | GitHub Readme Stats | Readme.so | GPRM |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Visual Live Canvas Editor** | ✅ Full WYSIWYG Editor | ❌ URL query params only | ✅ Static Markdown editor | ❌ Form only |
| **Real-time Dynamic SVGs** | ✅ Serverless Edge URLs | ✅ Yes | ❌ Static Markdown | ❌ Static SVGs |
| **Image-to-ASCII Art Generator** | ✅ Built-in Engine | ❌ No | ❌ No | ❌ No |
| **Native GitHub Theme Switching** | ✅ Automatic `<picture>` tags | ⚠️ Manual query config | ❌ No | ❌ No |
| **Multi-Profile Management** | ✅ Unlimited named profiles | ❌ Single profile | ❌ No | ❌ No |
| **Pricing & License** | ✅ 100% Free & Open Source (MIT) | Free & Open Source | Free tier / Paid | Free & Open Source |

## Quick How-To: Add GitAscii to GitHub Profile

1. Visit `https://gitascii.com/[username]` (replace `[username]` with any GitHub handle).
2. Customize widgets (ASCII art, tech stack, contribution stats, themes) in the visual editor.
3. Copy the generated SVG endpoint or embed snippet.
4. Paste into the special repository README: `github.com/[username]/[username]/README.md`.

### Markdown Embed Snippet
```markdown
![GitAscii Profile](https://gitascii.com/api/YOUR_GITHUB_USERNAME)
```

### Auto Dark & Light Mode Responsive Snippet
```html
<picture>
  <source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="https://gitascii.com/api/YOUR_GITHUB_USERNAME?theme=github-dark">
  <source media="(prefers-color-scheme: light)" srcset="https://gitascii.com/api/YOUR_GITHUB_USERNAME?theme=minimal">
  <img alt="GitAscii Profile" src="https://gitascii.com/api/YOUR_GITHUB_USERNAME">
</picture>
```

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### What makes GitAscii different from traditional GitHub stat cards?
Traditional cards require long URL query strings that are difficult to customize and preview. GitAscii provides a full visual UI, instant real-time live preview, custom ASCII art dithering, and decoupled edge rendering for ultra-low latency under GitHub Camo CDN.

### Is GitAscii free to use?
Yes, GitAscii is 100% free and open-source under the GNU General Public License v3.0 (GPLv3), with no watermarks or required paywalls.

### How does GitAscii handle GitHub Camo image caching?
GitAscii serves appropriate HTTP Cache-Control headers (`public, max-age=14400, s-maxage=14400, stale-while-revalidate=86400`) ensuring stats remain fresh without causing GitHub Camo timeout errors.
